faqs.a:
The contributions of the city to the police pension fund from the general revenue
               of the city shall be 10.469 percent per month, effective January 1, 1979; provided,
               however, this contribution by the city may be increased or decreased by the city council
               with the approval of at least 65 percent of all policemen employed by the city at
               the time the contribution is increased or decreased, and by at least 65 percent of
               all former employees at the time the contribution is increased or decreased, who have
               earned pension rights or benefits, as long as the actuarial soundness of the police
               pension fund is maintained.
(Code 1960, § 19-18(C); Code 1981, § 26-8)
